hypothesis: Bounded full-trip scalar fission can split independent unconditional add/fadd reductions while retaining producer-local first-order or mutually dependent scalar state. Closed extractable accumulators need not require every header PHI to be a reduction, original-loop vectorizability or a pressure/depth/reduction-count profitability gate. This revision repairs validation of that inherited extension: ABI padding depends on the insertion order of unique contribution streams, so reversed accumulator PHIs can change reserved scratch bytes without changing capacity, traffic or semantics. Production and immutable benchmark inputs are unchanged.
semantics: The inherited unconditional extraction proof requires the accumulator PHI's sole user to be its update, whose only users are its own backedge PHI and final exit LCSSA PHIs. Compact extraction retains its existing update/bypass/merge closure. State feeding predicates, addresses, contributions, other reductions or partial exports cannot be extracted. Nonextractable scalar header PHIs remain in the original producer with their starts, backedges, operations, flags, CFG and execution order; at least one closed add/fadd reduction is required. Retained producer live-outs and retained state plus compact participation remain rejected. The existing effect/call/load whitelist, trip/termination proofs, bounds, ordinal/completed/participating counts, masks, tails, alias behavior, live-outs and stage metadata are unchanged. Ordinary unconstrained unflagged FP preserves per-reduction order and operand order under both settings of the separate fission FP-reordering option; strictfp/constrained FP remain rejection contracts. No d2 chunk/export support is imported. The prior explicit export exit PHIs, defined bypass values and observable stores remain intact. This repair changes only recurrence_runtime's byte expectation and the fixture checker: each matrix row now supplies an exact stream-order byte sum, and a shared remark certificate checks that count, capacity, original source location and stage VFs. Repeated LV may revisit a stage but must select each original loop only once. The focused lit regression checks the execution matrix's shared fixture table against independent literal expectations, then uses actual scalar and repeated-LV vector/tail remarks for both stream orders, all eleven scalar locations and all three scalar capacity boundaries; 24 new mutations reject swapped byte counts, numeric-prefix byte counts, wrong capacity/location and wrong producer/consumer VFs. All inherited checker mutations, typed scratch provenance, retained-state instruction/order certificates, ordered vector/scalar FP and exact count checks remain. Executable verification remains the full original IR / actual transformed paths / independent C-formula matrix, including aliases, enclosing carry/reuse, zero/one-trip, capacity boundaries, vector consumers and scalar tails. Separate strict and explicitly reordered runs and uninstrumented RVV machine verification are requested from the harness; no compilation, tests or executable comparisons were run by this worker.
costs: No production allocation, schedule, guard or analysis changes. Full-trip reserved scratch is the insertion-order sum of ABI-aligned unique contribution streams, capped at 65536 bytes and the signed pointer-index ceiling; no final-stream padding is charged by the existing accounting. Seven integer-first capacity-65 fixtures reserve i32[65] then double[65], 260+4+520=784 bytes. recurrence_runtime reverses the extracted accumulator PHIs and reserves double[65] then i32[65], 520+260=780 bytes. This intentionally corrects the former blanket 784-byte expectation. Integer-first capacities 1/255/5461 retain 4+4+8=16, 1020+4+2040=3064 and 21844+4+43688=65536 bytes. Every fixture still stores 12 bytes and loads 12 bytes per completed iteration: 24*N logical scratch traffic, independent of reserved capacity and of two integer accumulators sharing one stream. Enclosing rows reuse the same entry allocations: 24*sum(row N) traffic with no capacity growth per row. No recurrence-state arrays, masks or unbounded storage are added. Original inputs and helpers execute once per original iteration/path; no extra original-input rereads, producer duplication or contribution recomputation. Original entry guards, ordinary LV vector/tail checks and noncanonical ordinal/completed arithmetic remain; no new alias/SCEV/FP guards. The inherited production recognizer uses direct PHI/update/merge user scans, a retained-state bit and existing scalar-type, effect and live-out scans, linear in visited instructions/uses/CFG edges apart from unchanged SCEV queries. The repair replaces a universal padding formula with eleven explicit fixture byte sums and factors existing exact remark assertions into one small helper shared with lit; it adds no generic layout machinery or profitability model. Physical stack traffic, spills, pressure, RVV execution and speedup remain unmeasured.
limitations: This worker ran no compiler, build, test runner or executable comparison. The immutable t000039 result records successful compilation and 48/49 mandatory lit files passing; its positive recurrence fixture passed EVL checks but failed the subsequent exact-source byte remark. Later RUN lines, VectorizeTests, full executable comparisons and primary corpus compilations were not validated there. This repair and the inherited recurrence extension require fresh harness-only validation. Retained state plus compact consumers, producer live-outs, chunk scheduling, arbitrary cyclic producer CFGs, early exits, unsafe calls/stores/volatile/atomics, unavailable/oversized finite bounds and strictfp/constrained FP retain their existing restrictions. Conditional retained-state merges and pointer recurrences are not separately exercised by the recurrence execution matrix. Certificates remain fixture-scoped, not general IR equivalence or ABI-layout solvers; whole-function aggregate scratch budgets are unchanged. Fixed-vscale host execution is not RVV execution, and RVV machine verification is not a speedup measurement. No new corpus selection, speedup, maturity, merge result or change to d2/t000036 integration pins is claimed.

Integer-first capacity-65 siblings remain 784, precisely 260+4+520. The final stream is not padded by the existing accounting; accepting either byte count indiscriminately would be incorrect. Both orders still have 24 bytes of logical scratch traffic per completed iteration.

All original positive function IR and positive .ll RUN commands, capacities, source locations, production use closure, C references, dispatch cases and every inherited checker mutation remain. The focused checker RUN commands now capture scalar and repeated-LV tail remarks. Capacity 1/255/5461 typed allocations, consumers, exact byte counts and scalar execution obligations remain unchanged.

All eleven new positive functions formerly fail the old requirement that every non-control header PHI be a supported reduction; each now has actual original/transformed/independent execution coverage requested, including ordered FP and integer results. No pre-existing correctness obligation is removed.

Two existing affine feedback rejection remarks change from scalar-unsupported-recurrence to scalar-unsupported-live-out: feedback prevents extraction of that accumulator, which is retained, and its exported final value then fails the unchanged producer live-out check. Their no-split and result checks remain. Existing single-accumulator rejection diagnostics retain their first recognition failure when nothing can be extracted.

New rejections cover accumulator PHI/update/predicate/address/other-reduction feedback, partial accumulator exports, retained state exports, stores/effectful calls, unavailable bounds, the first over-capacity mixed stream (5462), strictfp/constrained FP, no extractable add/fadd, and retained state with compact participation.

The new checker test uses actual scalar and LV2 vector/tail output. Positives include SSA-renamed retained recurrences and normal LV removal of integer nowrap flags. Mutations preserve all inherited checker tests and reject wrong recurrence starts/backedges/operands/opcodes/order, moved/duplicated state work, wrong scratch capacity/index/store count, bound-as-consumer-count and FP reassociation.
